The duty-cycle number stands; its attribution to the commit gate does not. Do NOT cite this as evidence for a gate rescale -- that route is retired.

confound_correction.finding: Both source runs (V3-EXQ-785, V3-EXQ-785a) ran with NO z_world warmup -- verified: the 785a driver contains zero zworld_p0/run_zworld_p0/warmup references and neither manifest config carries a warmup/p0/zworld key. That is the SAME confound the 2026-09-04 spike (evidence/planning/mech465_zworld_warmup_dispersion_spike_20260904.md) identified in the three MECH-465 commit-gate probes: they measured a frozen random-projection z_world with a near-degenerate CEM policy.
confound_correction.owning_front: substrate_queue MECH465-COMMIT-GATE-HEADROOM, node_class 'complex (probe-gated)', ready=false, next step a warmup-budget sweep PROBE owned by governance via GFLAG-0136. IMPL-016 is the FOURTH claim observed to hit this same regime (after MECH-463, MECH-465, and MECH-027 via failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-981_2026-09-03).
confound_correction.supersedes_in_this_artifact: The notes field's implication that threshold recalibration is the natural release lever. It is NOT: substrate_queue MECH465-COMMIT-GATE-HEADROOM records the gate-rescale route as RETIRED 2026-09-04 ('Do NOT build the gate rescale'; threshold recalibration does not converge -- the calibration target moves 35-165% while the graded band is only 2.7-4.5% wide).
confound_correction.what_it_changes: ATTRIBUTION, not the operational conclusion. The measured duty cycle (99.55% committed; all uncommitted ticks in the warm-up transient) is a fact about these recorded runs and stands, so IMPL-016's epistemic commitment gate remains untestable on them. But the 55.5x margin must NOT be read as a property of the commit GATE: the 2026-09-04 spike showed that warming z_world with run_zworld_p0 raises within-seed IQR(running_variance)/median MONOTONICALLY with warmup budget on 3/3 seeds (up to 8.3x), and the trend had not plateaued. An unknown share of the saturation reported here is therefore attributable to the untrained encoder rather than to the gate.

method_note: Re-read the recorded per-tick JSONL sidecars (fields: committed, commit_variance, effective_threshold) of two MECH-463 runs sharing substrate_hash 849de508. Primary source is V3-EXQ-785a, the latch-cleared reference implementation for per-tick E3 diagnostics (it clears agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics before every select_action, so each row is one genuine selection); V3-EXQ-785 corroborates but predates that fix and may carry pseudo-replication, so it is cited as corroboration only. Counted committed vs uncommitted ticks and located each uncommitted tick in its seed's tick sequence. No new compute.
notes: GOV-REUSE-1 consumer check for IGW-20260905-234 / proposal EXP-0620 (EVB-1303). FINDING: the ARC-016 commit predicate (committed = running_variance < commitment_threshold) is SATURATED ON at the default operating point. running_variance decays from its 0.5 init to ~2.5e-3 within ~10 ticks and stays there, against a default commitment_threshold of 0.40 -- a median 55.5x margin. All 8 uncommitted ticks in 785a are the warm-up transient (tick 0 at the 0.5 init, plus ticks 7-9 during decay); zero uncommitted ticks occur after tick 10 in any seed. NOTE the converged variance (~2.5e-3) sits ~4x BELOW the bottom of the band variance_commit_threshold's own docstring declares intended (~0.01-0.05), so recalibrating the threshold into that documented band would NOT restore uncommitted windows either. MECH-108's breath-sweep threshold reduction, written explicitly to prevent 'the agent becomes permanently committed', does not produce uncommitted windows at this converged variance. CONSEQUENCE for IMPL-016: any experiment testing the epistemic commitment gate on the current substrate would contrast ~1757 committed observations against ~8 initialisation-transient ones -- criteria_non_degenerate: false by construction, a vacuous PASS rather than a verdict. This is why proposal EXP-0620 is marked blocked_substrate rather than queued.
question: Does the V3 substrate present a non-degenerate population of UNCOMMITTED E3 selections, as required to test IMPL-016's epistemic commitment gate (uncommitted rollouts do not drive belief update; committed trajectories do)?
